newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cortecs says to develop cancer tests.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cortecs says to develop cancer tests.

text.p: Drug developer Cortecs International Ltd said on Thursday it had signed an agreement with Cancer Research Campaign Technology Ltd (CRCT) for the development of diagnostic tests for nasopharngeal cancer.

The company said it plans to initiate a programme aimed at developing and commercialising a series of diagnostic products, using whole blood, plasma, serum or saliva, suitable to assist in diagnosing nasopharngeal cancer.
Cortecs shares closed steady at A$3.27 on turnover of 18,700 shares.
